Libraries
```{r}

#for mefisto : stuck at Sigma node for Mefisto? 
library(reticulate)
reticulate::use_condaenv("mofa2_env", required = TRUE)
reticulate::py_config()
reticulate::py_module_available("mofapy2")


library(ggplot2)
library(svdx)
library(svdxBenchmark)
library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)
library(Biobase)
```



```{r}
require(dplyr)
dir0 <- "./data/raw/bbs/bbs_svdx_starter/" 
Y_mean <- readRDS( paste0(dir0,"/data_intermediate/Y_species_x_grid_year_mean_count.rds") )
xdata  <- readRDS( paste0(dir0, "/data_intermediate/xdata_grid_year_frozen.rds") )
fdata  <- readRDS( paste0(dir0, "/data_intermediate/fdata_species.rds") )
feature_sets <- readRDS( paste0(dir0,"/data_intermediate/feature_sets.rds") )
xdata <- as.data.frame(xdata)
rownames(xdata) <- colnames(Y_mean)
zdata <- xdata

#some filtering for very uncommon taxa
si <- which( (!is.na(xdata$breeding_mean_temperature)) & (!is.na(xdata$breeding_cumulative_precipitation)) )
Y_mean <- Y_mean[,si]
xdata <- xdata[si,]
xdata$yearFac <- factor(xdata$year)
zdata <- xdata

ig <- which( rowSums(Y_mean>0) < 10 )
names_ig <- rownames(Y_mean)[ig]
Y_mean <- Y_mean[-ig, ]
fdata <- fdata[-ig, ]


```


# Define SVDX formulas
```{r formulas}
xformula = ~lat_center*lon_center 
zformula = ~yearFac
zdata <- xdata
```

# Optional inputs
```{r optional-inputs}
row_offsets <- rep(0, nrow(Y_mean))
col_offsets <- rep(0, ncol(Y_mean))
tj <- col_offsets

```

# Preprocess

```{r preprocess}
fdata <- as_svdx_fdata(
  fdata,
  feature_col = "species_id", #these are the rownames in the circ data
  label_col = "common_name", #these are what we will use for labeling features in plots
  enrichment_col = "species_id" #these are what we will use for enrichment when we do inferecne
)


prepared <- svdx:::prepare_svdx_data(
  Y = Y_mean,
  xdata = xdata,
  zdata = zdata,
  xformula = xformula,
  zformula = zformula,
  fdata = fdata,
  family = NULL, 
  log1p_transform = TRUE,              #already transformed      
  t_j = tj,
  normalize = FALSE,                    #data has already been normalization
  top_ftrs = 5000,
  center_rows = TRUE,    
  scale_rows = TRUE,
  allow_sparse_densification = TRUE,
  col_offset = col_offsets,
  row_offset = row_offsets,
  dataset_name = "bbs"
)
```


Run 
```{r}

METHODS <- c(
  "svdx",
  "pca",
  #"mefisto_duplicate_view", #no mefisto as stuck at "optimizing sigma node"?
  "nmf",
  "mixomics_pls",
  "spca",
  "sparse_nmf"
)
SPCA_KEEPX_GRID <- round(c(0.01, 0.25, 0.5) * nrow(prepared$Y))
SPARSE_NMF_LAMBDA_GRID <- 10^c(-3, -2, -1)

rw_single <- run_real_world_single_benchmark(
  
  Y = prepared$Y,
  data = prepared$xdata,
  xformula = prepared$xformula,
  zdata = prepared$zdata,
  zformula = prepared$zformula,
  fdata = fdata, 
  
  K = 15, 

  methods = METHODS, 
  spca_keepX_grid = SPCA_KEEPX_GRID,
  sparse_nmf_lambda_grid = SPARSE_NMF_LAMBDA_GRID,
  mefisto_covariates = c("lat_center", "lon_center"),
  
  inference_methods = c("svdx"), ftol_abs = 1e-5, fitter_maxIter=1000,
  

  run_factorization = TRUE,
  run_inference = TRUE,
  
  inference_scope = "all",
  feature_sets = feature_sets,
  enrichment_backend = "internal"
  
)




rw <- runSingleBenchmarkReports(rw_single = rw_single,
                                    outdir = "./bbs", overwrite=T, 
                                 color="BCR", group="BCR", line_group = "BCR",
                                xaxis="lon_center", 
                                 loading_enrichment = T, 
                                 enrichment_top_n = 25, 
                                svdx_report_args = list( z_adjustment = "fitted", 
                                                         heatmap_order_by = c("year", "lon_center", "lat_center"), 
                                                         feature_profile_show_se = T , 
                                                         feature_profile_color = "BCR", 
                                                         feature_profiles_top_n = 10L,
                                                         x =year, 
                                                         yaxis = "lat_center" 
                                                         )
                                 )

```
